image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of an African crocodile (Nile crocodile) resting on sandy ground. The image focuses primarily on the head and upper torso, showing detailed skin texture, bony scutes, and an open mouth revealing interlocking teeth. The eye is visible with a vertical pupil. The background is blurred sand.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a distinct V-shape, consistent with crocodilian morphology and distinct from the U-shape of alligators.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Teeth are clearly visible, conical, and appear to interlock correctly. The fourth lower tooth fits into the upper jaw notch as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eye is positioned on top of the skull. Vertical slit pupil is clearly visible. The eye structure looks anatomically correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Nostrils are visible at the anterior tip of the snout, consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows heavy armor plating and extends out of frame, implying elongation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct, rough, bony scutes are visible in organized rows along the back and neck.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Coloration is earthy brown/grey with significant textural detail matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral surface (belly) is not visible in this angle; the crocodile is viewed from above/side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs are completely occluded by the body or outside the frame in this close-up crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the frame.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out look-alikes like alligators or other crocodilians based on snout shape and scale pattern.
To detect subtle texture anomalies, melting, or inconsistent lighting often found in AI-generated reptile skin and complex tooth structures.
To ensure the boundary between the open mouth, teeth, and tongue is structurally sound and not fused or bleeding into the background.
To verify that the protruding eyes and snout have correct 3D spatial relationships and do not exhibit geometric flattening or warping.

focus_areas: Edge sharpness between subject and sandy background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the teeth alignment. AI often struggles with the specific 'interlocking' nature of crocodile teeth where the 4th lower tooth fits into the upper jaw. Verify if the texture of the scutes is repetitive (a common AI artifact) or naturally varied. Check for any 'melting' around the eye socket.
